topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen- and damage-associated molecular patterns
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the nature of PAMPs and DAMPs and the criteria used to detect infections and distinguish self from non-self.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptors and signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the genetics, cellular localization, major families, and downstream signaling mechanisms of pattern recognition receptors.

topics.label: Sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells direct immune cell extravasation, lymphatic drainage, and systemic inflammatory escalation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the mechanisms that shut down inflammation, repair damaged tissue, and mediate chronic inflammatory states such as granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the subject of the next lecture.
